Change which views an atlas has, and where they sit

Source: R/atlas_utils.R
view_manipulation.Rd

Verbs that act on views as objects:

Usage

atlas_view_remove(atlas, views, match = c("exact", "pattern"))

atlas_view_keep(atlas, views, match = c("exact", "pattern"))

atlas_view_gather(atlas, gap = 0.15)

atlas_view_reorder(atlas, order, gap = 0.15)

Arguments

atlas

A ggseg_atlas object

views

View names to act on. Matched whole and case-insensitively against the atlas's own views, so a name has to be one atlas_views() reports. Give them as a character vector, or in one string separated by "|"; the two are equivalent. Names that match no view are warned about and otherwise ignored.

match

How views is read. "exact", the default, takes each name as a whole view name. "pattern" takes views as a regular expression instead, matched as a substring — "axial" then reaches axial_1 and axial_2 as well. Prefer "exact": a name that happens to sit inside another view's name silently takes both views with it under "pattern".

gap

Proportional gap between views (default 0.15 = 15% of max width).

order

For atlas_view_reorder(): character vector of desired view order. Unspecified views appended at end.

Value

Modified ggseg_atlas object

Details

  • atlas_view_remove(): remove entire views

  • atlas_view_keep(): keep only matching views

  • atlas_view_reorder(): change view order

  • atlas_view_gather(): reposition views to close gaps

None of these changes what is drawn inside a view. For that — dropping a region's depiction in some views while the region itself stays — see drawing_manipulation.

Functions

  • atlas_view_keep(): Keep only views matching pattern. Remaining views are re-packed via atlas_view_gather() so the layout stays tight, as atlas_view_remove() does.

  • atlas_view_gather(): Reposition remaining views to close gaps after view removal.

  • atlas_view_reorder(): Reorder views and reposition. Views not in order are appended at end.

See also

atlas_manipulation for the other groups

Other atlas manipulations: atlas_core_add(), atlas_manipulation, atlas_relabel(), atlas_structure_reorder(), drawing_manipulation, region_manipulation

Examples

# Views are named by the atlas, so ask it rather than naming one here.
dk() |> atlas_view_keep(atlas_views(dk())[1])
